prompt: State the two essential physical conditions that must be satisfied for the kinematic equations of motion (suvat equations) to be valid.
hints: Consider the type of acceleration assumed when deriving these equations.
Consider the geometric dimension/path of the motion.
solution: 1. Acceleration must be constant (uniform). 2. Motion must be along a straight line (one dimension).
teacher_walkthrough: Step 1: State condition 1: constant (or uniform) acceleration [1 mark].
Step 2: State condition 2: straight-line motion (or rectilinear / 1D) [1 mark].
